description: Preclearing Porti is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministero Infrastrutture e Trasporti. Questo dataset contiene i dati di preclearing, la procedura di sdoganamento in mare per importazione merci da paesi terzi, effetuate nei maggiori porti italiani. Coverage: Italy. The portal files it under the publisher Ministero Infrastrutture e Trasporti. Its tags are dogana, minf, porto, preclearing, sdoganamento. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, PDF. The portal shows 2026-01-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
